schema.family_id: stable identifier for the catalyst/precursor family
schema.label: human-readable family name
schema.metal: metal center for the family (Pd, Ni, Cu, Co, etc.)
schema.oxidation_states: typical oxidation state(s) supplied by this family (list of ints)
schema.precursor_class: category label (e.g., Pd(0) source, Pd(II) salt, preformed Pd–ligand complex, NHC–Pd precatalyst)
schema.aliases: alternative family labels used in literature (optional)
schema.ehs_green: EHS/green flags at family or member level
schema.example_members: array of {name, abbr, cas, synonyms, properties, embedding_text} items
schema.preferred_reactions: subset of use_cases that the family is especially good at (array of strings)
schema.handling: typical handling flags at FAMILY level: {air_sensitive: bool, moisture_sensitive: bool, notes?: str}
schema.additional_ligand: family-level default for ligand need: {usage: 'required' | 'optional' | 'not_needed', typical: [abbr/names], notes: str}
schema.recommended_pairs: family-level list of suggested pairings when selecting ligands/reductants/solvents. Each item: {for_reactions:[], with_ligand: {family_id?: str, examples: [abbr]}, co_reagents: {reductant?:[], base?:[]}, solvents:[], temp_C: [low, high], loadings: {catalyst_mol%: str, ligand_mol%: str, ratio_L_to_M?: float}, notes: str}

schema_extensions.example_members[*].redox: dict of redox potentials vs SCE (solvent when known): {E_ox, E_red, E_star_ox, E_star_red, scale, solvent, source}
schema_extensions.example_members[*].additional_ligand: member-level override of family default (same shape as family-level field)
schema_extensions.example_members[*].recommended_pairs: member-level list overriding or specializing family defaults (same shape as family field)
